data_sources.labels_and_fire_history: NASA FIRMS VIIRS NOAA-20 standard processing (SP), 2018-12..2025-12
data_sources.weather: ECMWF IFS HRES 9 km daily via Open-Meteo archive (temperature_2m_max, temperature_2m_mean, relative_humidity_2m_mean, wind_speed_10m_max, precipitation_sum; local day 19:00-19:00 UTC)

serving_weather: Open-Meteo Forecast API (past_days=3, forecast_days=3) and Historical Forecast API, models=ecmwf_ifs, timezone Asia/Kolkata (day = 19:00..19:00 UTC); temp_max/temp_min = max/min of the 24 hourly temperature_2m values (a day with any missing hour stays missing); temp_mean, rh_mean, wind_max, precip_sum = API daily aggregates
test_disclosure: The 2025 test year was exposed once before the official Kaggle run: a local CPU smoke run of train_wildfire_v3.py on a 60k-row train subsample (to check the script end to end) printed 2025 test metrics for that throwaway model (ROC ~0.921) and for v2 on 2025 rows (IFS ROC 0.920 / PR 0.809; POWER ROC 0.921 / PR 0.811). Its outputs were deleted; nothing (features, params, thresholds, rounds) was tuned or chosen from it. Params, seed and features are v2's fixed ones; thresholds come from validation year 2024. The official test score is the single Kaggle GPU run.
